name: org.openrewrite.gitlab.MigrateToRules
description: Replace the deprecated `only` and `except` keywords with equivalent `rules` in `.gitlab-ci.yml` job definitions. When both `only` and `except` are present, they are combined into a single `rules` block. Handles simple ref list forms, matching named refs as branches; complex object forms with `refs`, `variables`, or `changes` sub-keys are left unchanged.

name: org.openrewrite.gitlab.OrderKeywords
description: Order the keywords in `.gitlab-ci.yml` consistently. Global keywords come first, in the order `include`, `stages`, `variables`, `workflow` and `default`, followed by the jobs in their original order. Within `default` and each job, keywords follow the order in which they take effect: inheritance, scheduling, execution environment, scripts and finally outputs such as `artifacts`. Unrecognized keys keep their relative order after the recognized ones. A mapping is left unchanged when reordering would place a YAML alias before its anchor.
